summary: Iteration 8 refactor-verification: NO regressions from the code-quality changes. Backend pytest suite: 68/68 pass (-n 0 sequential, ~60s) — test_app_settings_and_pwa 19/19, test_site_images (hero/why/gallery incl. self-heal), test_cleaner_tracking 20/20, backend_test.py. All tests read ADMIN_PASSWORD from backend/.env via conftest.py — no hardcoded creds. Image endpoints verified: GET /api/app-images/file/tidyups-quote/app/0f13d95a-be19-453c-9409-62a66316df07.jpg → 200 image/jpeg; GET /api/site-images/file/bogus.png → 404 (not 500) — try/except restructure of serve_site_image and serve_app_image is correct; GET /api/site-images → hero + why + 4 gallery items; GET /api/app-images → 5 items with fit field. PWA head verified: <link rel=manifest>, <meta theme-color=#0A0611>, external <style>body{background-color:#0A0611}</style> (string child, NOT dangerouslySetInnerHTML), <script src=/register-sw.js defer>. GET /register-sw.js → 200 application/javascript, content registers /sw.js with console.warn on failure. GET /manifest.json, /sw.js, /icons/icon-192.png all 200. Playwright (390px mobile viewport, chromium): SW actually registered — navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned 1 within 1s of load. Home tab: hero-title + home-cta-call + home-cta-quote + 5 promo-card-N + tabs (home/services/quote/gallery/contact) all render. Contact tab: business hours render correctly (Monday–Friday 8AM–6PM, Saturday 9AM–4PM, Sunday Closed) — the `${day}-${index}` React key change did not break rendering; contact-phone/tollfree/address/website + staff-login-link + cleaner-checkin-link all present. Gallery: images render. Admin (localStorage tidyups_admin_pw='tidyups2026' + /admin route): all 4 tabs render (admin-tab-leads/images/business/team) and Leads tab shows 3 admin-lead-card entries. ZERO console errors across all pages. Only expected warnings: (a) expo-notifications push-token limitation on web (pre-existing, not this iter), (b) new console.warn from business.js catch when a background fetch briefly fails — this is exactly the new logging added this iter working as designed. No new console errors from any of the touched files (leadAlerts.js, lastQuote.js, business.js, gallery.js, contact.js, +html.js).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains ~787 lines mixing cleaners + app-images + site-images + settings + sheets + sms — carry-over from iter 7 recommendation to split into routes/ modules. Not a bug, but growing pressure.

+html.js: External register-sw.js is the correct fix over dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Consider also moving the inline `<style>{'body{background-color:#0A0611}'}</style>` into a link to /theme.css eventually so the head is 100% static — cosmetic, current form is CSP-safe as a string child (no XSS surface).

business.js/leadAlerts.js/lastQuote.js/gallery.js catch console.warn: good addition. Consider a single tiny logger (e.g., src/lib/log.js exporting warn/error that no-ops in production) so warns don't leak to end-users' consoles in a deployed PWA — future polish.
contact.js hours key `${day}-${index}` is safe (day names are unique; index disambiguates in case of dupes). This was already unique with day names alone, but the change is defensive and harmless.
test_cleaner_tracking.py still requires -n 0 (documented in iter 7). Consider marking with @pytest.mark.serial + xdist dist=loadscope, OR fetch current PIN dynamically per-test — carry-over.
